text:
Maya D: Hey team — tiny UX check. I added a 'Simulate notification' flow in the Alerting > SLO threshold editor's Notification Preview. It renders a fake alert so you can confirm formatting, channel rendering, and suppression behavior without sending real messages. Figma: https://figma.redwood/example (WIP)
Oliver K: Nice idea. Is simulation on by default? Seems risky if people assume it's sending.
Maya D: Off by default. You have to click 'Run simulation'. Current helper copy: 'Simulate notification — no outbound messages are sent' (placeholder). Thoughts on wording and placement?
Samir: Shorter copy for compact widths: 'Preview only — no messages sent'
Chris (PM): Also need a11y + keyboard flow: when the preview panel is active, tabbing should move into preview controls and Esc should close the simulation. Ensure focus returns to the Run button.
Zara - Eng: Implementation note: backend will hit /preview endpoint with a header so it knows not to dispatch. We plan to send `X-Simulated: true`. Example:
```
GET /preview?policy=notify
X-Simulated: true
```
DesignBot: Accessibility check: ensure the Run Simulation button uses `aria-pressed` when active and has an `aria-describedby` pointing to the helper copy. Also add a live region announce when simulation starts: "Simulation mode active, messages will not be sent."
Maya D: Good calls. UI question: inline simulation controls in the preview panel vs a modal. Inline keeps context, modal is clearer on mobile. I sketched inline for desktop + responsive modal for small screens.
Oliver K: Inline for desktops feels faster. Modal fallback on narrow viewports makes sense.
Samir: Copy tweak: maybe 'Preview (simulation) — no messages will be sent' reads clearer in the header.
Chris (PM): Small visual nit — preview header should include channel icon + name on the left; copy left-aligned. Divider between preview and channel list needs slightly higher contrast.
Zara - Eng: Perf nit: channel avatars in the live preview cause lots of reflows in long lists. Suggest lazy-load avatars and fallback to initials for the sim mode.
Maya D: I'll update the Figma to reflect copy options and inline/modal responsive behavior. Will add aria-live snippet too.
Oliver K: I can take the accessibility pass and run VoiceOver + NVDA checks. Will report any issues. :thumbsup:
DesignBot: Added checklist item to the thread: [ ] update copy, [ ] add aria-live announce, [ ] keyboard trap tests, [ ] mobile modal behavior.
Maya D: Thanks! If anyone's got short copy alternatives, paste them here and I'll try them in the mockup.
